Beaconing.description: Outbound connections at a regular interval (C2).

Failed logins.description: Repeated authentication attempts with a wrong password.

DNS Poisoning.description: Manipulation of DNS cache to redirect traffic to unauthorized or malicious IP addresses.

SQL Injection.description: Insertion of malicious SQL statements into entry fields for execution or data leakage.

Brute Force.description: High volume of rapid authentication attempts targeting multiple accounts or variations.

Data Exfiltration.description: Unauthorized transfer of sensitive data from inside the network to an external destination.

Ransomware Activity.description: Massive and rapid modification of file extensions and headers indicating bulk encryption.
